name: Idaho
agency: Idaho Transportation Department (ITD), Division of Motor Vehicles
permitAge: 14 and a half (Driver Training permit, valid only with the driver training instructor; the supervised instruction period follows driver training; license from 15; handbook pp. 3, 15, 19)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night (handbook p. 19; Idaho Code 49-307(8)(b))
teen.holdPermit: 6 months, violation-free; a traffic conviction cancels the permit and the 6 months start over with a new permit (handbook p. 19)
teen.nightLimit: Licensed drivers under 16: daylight hours only, defined as 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. local time, unless a licensed driver 21 or older sits in the front seat beside them (handbook p. 16; Idaho Code 49-307(10))
teen.passengerLimit: Licensed under 17, first 6 months: no more than one passenger under 17, relatives by blood, adoption or marriage excepted (handbook p. 16; Idaho Code 49-307(11))
teen.phone: All drivers: hands-free only (Idaho Code 49-1401A, since July 1, 2020), including while stopped in traffic or at a signal; one touch or voice to start a call; hand-held only when lawfully parked or pulled off the road, or in an emergency. Fines $75 / $150 / $300 within 3 years. The July 2024 handbook (p. 92) still describes only the texting ban.

notes: Handbook: Idaho Driver's Handbook, July 2024 edition (PDF dated 2024-12-23, posted under uploads/2025/03). Printed page numbers equal PDF page numbers. Read in full on 2026-10-09.

Knowledge test: 40 questions, may miss up to 6 (handbook p. 32). Offered in English, Arabic, Chinese, Farsi, French, Korean, Russian, Serbo-Croatian, Spanish, Swahili, Vietnamese and ASL (p. 32). Applicants must be 15 to take the knowledge and skills tests; a failed test needs a 3-day wait.
Permit age: Driver Training permit from 14 1/2 (handbook p. 15; Idaho Code 49-307(4)); the supervised instruction period starts after driver training; license from 15 (p. 3).
Supervisor during SIP: licensed, at least 21, in the seat beside the driver, no other front-seat passengers; all occupants belted; permit carried while driving (handbook p. 19; Idaho Code 49-307(8)).

Driver training required under 17: 30 h classroom, 6 h in-car observation, 6 h behind the wheel (handbook p. 19). Idaho Code 49-307(6), amended 2025-2026 after the handbook, lets a qualifying parent teach the 6 + 6 hours, with the 30 classroom hours taken online.
Daylight for under-16 licensees is 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. (handbook p. 16, Idaho Code 49-307(10)(b)); an earlier draft said half an hour before sunrise to after sunset, which was wrong.
Move Over (handbook p. 95; Idaho Code 49-624, tow trucks and incident response added 2019): slow below the limit, and change lanes away when there are two or more lanes in your direction.
Under 21 with 0.02 to under 0.08, first offense: one-year court suspension, first 90 days absolute (Idaho Code 18-8004A(1)(b)). BAC limits .02 under 21, .04 commercial, .08 adults (handbook p. 131).
Spanish manual: https://itd.idaho.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Spanish_manual.pdf (HTTP 200, PDF, not read in this check).
